observations.meaning: Algorithmic eigengap screening resolution for each candidate set; candidate_k=1 means the dominant spectral gap is at the single-cluster resolution.
observations.finding: All seven candidate sets (K7_C0001 through K7_C0007) screen at candidate_k=1, so no dominant multi-cluster subdivision signal is identified at the partition level.

observations.meaning: Magnitude of the leading spectral gap at the screened resolution for each candidate set.
observations.finding: Leading gaps are moderate to large for the larger sets (roughly 0.115-0.157) and smaller for the smallest set K7_C0007 (0.044), consistent with the single-cluster resolution dominating rather than indicating internal multi-cluster substructure.

observations.meaning: Full eigengap profile across candidate resolutions for each set.
observations.finding: For every set the first gap is far larger than subsequent gaps (subsequent gaps <=0.0054), so the dominant gap is located at k=1; this describes dominance of the single-cluster resolution and is not evidence of internal multi-cluster substructure.

observations.meaning: Average fused affinity among patients assigned to the same candidate set.
observations.finding: Within-set affinities are similar across sets (about 0.0096-0.0118), with the smallest set K7_C0007 showing the highest within-set affinity; these values describe internal cohesion of current membership in fused geometry.

observations.meaning: Relatively close candidate pairs and their average fused affinity across the current pair boundary; a pair-review entry point, not a merge conclusion.
observations.finding: The closest boundaries are K7_C0001-K7_C0004 (0.00925), K7_C0002-K7_C0003 (0.00921), and K7_C0001-K7_C0007 (0.00921); these between-set affinities are close to the within-set affinities, identifying boundaries for possible pair review without implying any merge.

observations.meaning: Number of patients represented in each structural calculation.
observations.finding: Set sizes range from 4 (K7_C0007) to 20 (K7_C0003); the smallest set has limited membership for stable structural estimation.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: At the partition level, structural diagnostics are triage evidence about whether current membership or boundaries are represented in the fused patient geometry. Within-set affinities are similar across sets, and the nearest-pair between-set affinities are close to within-set values, identifying relatively close boundaries (notably K7_C0001-K7_C0004, K7_C0002-K7_C0003, K7_C0001-K7_C0007) as entry points for pair review. These results do not establish retention, split, or merge, and no reclustering was performed.
